# RomP

> RomP is a free, open source desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that plays the games in a RomM library. It downloads each game and the right emulator, and syncs in-game saves and save states with the RomM server. It needs RomM 5.0 or newer, and includes no games or BIOS files.

RomM (https://romm.app) is a self-hosted server for a personal game collection. RomP is a client for it, made by an independent developer, not by the RomM team.

## Docs

- [Install](https://rompemu.github.io/install/): requirements and downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux, Homebrew, and connecting to a RomM server
- [Supported systems](https://rompemu.github.io/systems/): every system RomP plays and the emulator it uses
- [Save sync](https://rompemu.github.io/saves/): when saves sync, offline play, conflicts, saves shared with other apps, and limits
- [Questions and answers](https://rompemu.github.io/faq/): what RomP is, cost, privacy, controllers, RetroAchievements, comparison with RetroArch and OpenEmu, translations, plans

## Facts

- Platforms: macOS 11 or newer on Apple silicon; Windows and Linux on x86-64. Linux builds: AppImage, .deb, .rpm and tar.gz. Homebrew: `brew install --cask rompemu/tap/romp`.
- Needs a RomM server, version 5.0 or newer. RomM 5.4 adds sending games to RomP with Install on device, and notifications.
- Emulators: libretro cores, plus xemu for Xbox and RPCS3 for PS3, downloaded automatically the first time a system is played. More than 50 systems, from the Atari 2600 to the PS3.
- Saves: in-game saves and save states sync with RomM before and after playing. A save changed on two devices asks which to keep and backs up the other. Xbox and PS3 saves don't sync yet.
- Each game runs in its own sandboxed process.
- RetroAchievements: supported, with popups and leaderboards. Hardcore mode waits for RetroAchievements to approve RomP.
- Controllers: automatic, any button can be remapped, and the whole app works with a controller.
- Cost: free, with no paid features, ads, tracking or accounts of its own. License: GPL-3.0-or-later.
